import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

class Edge {
    int from, to;
    double length;
    Edge(int f, int t, double l) {
        this.from = f;
        this.to = t;
        this.length = l;
    }
}

class Node {
    List<Integer> outEdges = new ArrayList<>();
}

class Graph {
    List<Node> nodes = new ArrayList<>();
    List<Edge> edges = new ArrayList<>();

    Graph(int nNodes, int nEdges) {
        for (int i = 0; i < nNodes; i++) {
            nodes.add(new Node());
        }
        // edges list will be added dynamically
    }

    void addEdge(int from, int to, double length) {
        edges.add(new Edge(from, to, length));
        nodes.get(from).outEdges.add(edges.size() - 1);
    }

    List<Integer> findPath(int source, int sink, double[] flow, double[] pathCap) {
        PriorityQueue<int[]> pq = new PriorityQueue<>((a, b) -> Double.compare(b[0], a[0]));
        double[] capacity = new double[nodes.size()];
        int[] pred = new int[nodes.size()];
        Arrays.fill(pred, -1);
        Arrays.fill(capacity, 0);
        capacity[source] = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
        pq.offer(new int[]{(int)capacity[source], source});

        while (!pq.isEmpty() && capacity[sink] == 0) {
            int[] curr = pq.poll();
            double currCap = curr[0];
            int u = curr[1];

            for (int eIdx : nodes.get(u).outEdges) {
                Edge e = edges.get(eIdx);
                double eCap = e.length - flow[eIdx];
                if (eCap > 0 && Math.min(currCap, eCap) > capacity[e.to]) {
                    capacity[e.to] = Math.min(currCap, eCap);
                    pred[e.to] = eIdx;
                    pq.offer(new int[]{(int)capacity[e.to], e.to});
                }
            }
        }

        pathCap[0] = capacity[sink];
        List<Integer> path = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int eIdx = pred[sink]; eIdx != -1; eIdx = pred[edges.get(eIdx).from]) {
            path.add(eIdx);
        }
        return path;
    }

    double maxFlow(int s, int t) {
        Graph residual = new Graph(nodes.size(), 2 * edges.size());
        double[] flow = new double[2 * edges.size()];
        double totalFlow = 0;
        double cap;

        for (Edge e : edges) {
            residual.addEdge(e.from, e.to, e.length);
            residual.addEdge(e.to, e.from, 0);
        }

        double[] pathCap = new double[1];
        List<Integer> path = residual.findPath(s, t, flow, pathCap);
        while (pathCap[0] > 0) {
            for (int eIdx : path) {
                int revIdx = (eIdx % 2 == 0) ? eIdx + 1 : eIdx - 1;
                flow[eIdx] += pathCap[0];
                flow[revIdx] -= pathCap[0];
            }
            path = residual.findPath(s, t, flow, pathCap);
        }

        for (int eIdx : residual.nodes.get(s).outEdges) {
            totalFlow += flow[eIdx];
        }
        return totalFlow;
    }
}

class Room {
    int i, j;
    boolean[] infected = new boolean[61];
    boolean[] accessible = new boolean[61];
    int scientists, capsules;

    Room() {
        Arrays.fill(infected, false);
        Arrays.fill(accessible, true);
        scientists = 0;
        capsules = 0;
    }

    int getNodeId(int timestamp, int n) {
        return 2 + i + n * j + (n * n) * timestamp;
    }

    void setReactor() {
        Arrays.fill(accessible, false);
    }

    void setInfected(int timestamp) {
        if (accessible[timestamp]) {
            accessible[timestamp] = false;
            infected[timestamp] = true;
        }
    }
}

public class Main {
    static int n, t;
    static Room[][] floorplan = new Room[10][10];

    static void spreadInfection(int i, int j, int timestamp, int n) {
        if (floorplan[i][j].infected[timestamp]) {
            int nextTime = timestamp + 1;
            floorplan[i][j].setInfected(nextTime);
            if (i > 0) floorplan[i - 1][j].setInfected(nextTime);
            if (i < n - 1) floorplan[i + 1][j].setInfected(nextTime);
            if (j > 0) floorplan[i][j - 1].setInfected(nextTime);
            if (j < n - 1) floorplan[i][j + 1].setInfected(nextTime);
        }
    }

    static String idToString(int id, int n) {
        if (id == 0) return "source";
        if (id == 1) return "sink";
        int row = (id - 2) % n;
        int col = ((id - 2 - row) % (n * n)) / n;
        int timestamp = (id - 2 - row - col * n) / (n * n);
        return "(" + row + "," + col + "," + timestamp + ")";
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        t = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (floorplan[i][j] == null) floorplan[i][j] = new Room();
                floorplan[i][j].i = i;
                floorplan[i][j].j = j;
                char ch = line.charAt(j);
                if (ch == 'Y') {
                    floorplan[i][j].setReactor();
                } else if (ch == 'Z') {
                    floorplan[i][j].setInfected(0);
                } else {
                    floorplan[i][j].scientists = ch - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char ch = line.charAt(j);
                if (ch != 'Y' && ch != 'Z') {
                    floorplan[i][j].capsules = ch - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        for (int c = 0; c <= t; c++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    if (c < t) {
                        spreadInfection(i, j, c, n);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int totalNodes = n * n * (t + 1) + 2;
        Graph g = new Graph(totalNodes, 100 * 4 * 60);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                Room room = floorplan[i][j];
                int nodeIdStart = room.getNodeId(0, n);
                int nodeIdEnd = room.getNodeId(t, n);
                if (room.scientists > 0) g.addEdge(0, nodeIdStart, room.scientists);
                if (room.capsules > 0) g.addEdge(nodeIdEnd, 1, room.capsules);
                for (int c = 0; c < t; c++) {
                    if (room.capsules > 0) g.addEdge(nodeIdStart, nodeIdEnd, 1000);
                    if (room.accessible[c]) {
                        if (i > 0) {
                            Room other = floorplan[i - 1][j];
                            if (other.accessible[c]) {
                                g.addEdge(nodeIdStart, other.getNodeId(c + 1, n), 1000);
                            }
                        }
                        if (i < n - 1) {
                            Room other = floorplan[i + 1][j];
                            if (other.accessible[c]) {
                                g.addEdge(nodeIdStart, other.getNodeId(c + 1, n), 1000);
                            }
                        }
                        if (j > 0) {
                            Room other = floorplan[i][j - 1];
                            if (other.accessible[c]) {
                                g.addEdge(nodeIdStart, other.getNodeId(c + 1, n), 1000);
                            }
                        }
                        if (j < n - 1) {
                            Room other = floorplan[i][j + 1];
                            if (other.accessible[c]) {
                                g.addEdge(nodeIdStart, other.getNodeId(c + 1, n), 1000);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println((int)g.maxFlow(0, 1));
    }
}
